next_step: Dedicated pricing call + POC metrics review week of 2026-03-15
notes: Head of Product (Elliot Farr) leads evaluation — focused on embeddings-first search across product docs and event logs.

Initial hosted API POC completed (small dataset, 100k doc subset). Used Redwood hosted->Pinecone for vector index. Results: good relevance, ~35% cost reduction after applying Redwood Optimize batching suggestions.
Primary ask: predictable throughput for SaaS search feature (QPS spikes during morning and release windows). Considering Dedicated for isolated capacity and SLA.
Latency targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 150ms for semantic search (topK=10) under steady load; search throughput target 150-250 QPS with sub-200ms tail.
Batch ingestion: nightly job ~5M new event-derived vectors, window 2am-6am ET. Need high ingest throughput and connector support (S3, Snowflake, Airflow).
Vector DB integrations: currently PoC with Pinecone; evaluating Milvus/Weaviate for on-prem options. Want seamless connector experience and troubleshooting guidance from SE.
Data residency: US-only production, HIPAA not required but must meet SOC2 + audit logs + KMS for encryption at rest.
Cost sensitivity: mid-market — price predictability important. Interested in Reserved/Dedicated pricing vs pay-as-you-go tradeoffs.
Quote from Elliot on 2026-02-18 call: 'If we can hit reliable p95 under 200ms at 200 QPS and keep costs under our quota, Dedicated makes sense.'
Internal stakeholders: Product, Platform (infra), Security. Platform wants autoscaling policies and rollback behavior documented.

Redwood wins so far: strong profiling data from Redwood Console, actionable Optimize recommendations, and clear canary/rollout features. Questions remain on sustained batch ingestion performance and local vector DB ops.
Potential deal structure: 12-month dedicated commit + Optimize add-on for ongoing cost automation and quarterly quality regression alerts.

POC success metrics defined: (1) semantic relevance (MRR@10 > baseline), (2) p95 latency target met under 200 QPS, (3) nightly ingestion completes within maintenance window, (4) cost per 1M embeddings below $X threshold.
